description: This file contains implementation of graph rewriting helper functions for PyTorch JIT, including pattern matching and replacement for convolution operations, and utility functions for extracting function names and values from graphs.

methods.name: getFuncName
methods.description: Extracts the function name from a Value object representing a function.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a Value pointer from match and vmap based on a given name.

methods.name: getIValue
methods.description: Retrieves an optional IValue associated with a given name from match and vmap.

methods.name: replaceConvolutionWithAtenConv
methods.description: Replaces convolution patterns in the graph with aten:: convolution calls, supporting multiple convolution types and transposes.

methods.name: isClampFusable
methods.description: Determines if a clamp operation pattern is fusable based on match and vmap.
